# Reviewed, synthetic IBAN-shaped strings that may appear in this repository.
# security.yml fails the build on any IBAN-shaped string NOT listed here, so a real
# account number cannot be committed again without someone consciously adding it.
#
#   SK99…, LT99…   reserved synthetic block (bank code 99 does not exist)
#   SK1111…-SK9999…, SK0000…  repeated-digit fixtures used across the transfer tests
#   *MOCK*         MockGoCardlessBankDataClient fixtures
#   DE89370400440532013*, DE99999…, GB29NWBK…, GB82WEST…, LT600000…
#                  ISO 13616 / Wikipedia documentation examples
